shared: A lemming herd marching in file, where your front unit and the order deaths come in decide fights.
differ: What it runs on: an off-board Kit stockpile, deaths feeding the leader, or one voice at a time.

takes.label: The Kit stockpile
takes.line: Spare Kits pile up in an off-board Burrow; each turn you hoard them as fight HP or cash them into stats (Ferrywife).
takes.look_if: a herd that grows every turn and a keep-or-spend choice.

takes.label: Deaths feed the leader
takes.line: Each death buffs your Lead, Cliff-Singer sacrifices it on purpose, and Pups pile up on a Boom that halves when you lose.
takes.look_if: a quick-to-learn herd where every death pays off.

takes.label: Only the front speaks
takes.line: Only your front Lemming's text works, so slot order becomes a queue of leaders; Gerd and Trailbreaker pick who falls first.
takes.look_if: a brain-teaser about line order, not a swelling herd.
